findings.message: artifact.certify: bubble_map encodes varying "pop" values with the public renderer's default linear symbol diameter (and therefore radius), not an area scale. Circle area squares that interpolation, distorting magnitude comparisons. The public geo operand currently exposes no size-scale override.
